first.rationale: Current situation shows twin deterioration in activation (6% QoQ down) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ down). While simplify_onboarding and promotional_pricing are both proven levers, activation_messaging is the highest-leverage choice given the constraint of one experiment per week. Memory_91 shows activation messaging improved week-one engagement and first meaningful actions—directly addressing the activation decline. Memory_31 and memory_86 establish that both signup simplification and onboarding improvements drive activation lift; activation_messaging can amplify these without requiring structural changes. The competitor pricing pressure targets a different segment (price-sensitive SMB) than our core activation problem. Referral incentives (memory_57) work for established customers, not addressing the week-one activation gap. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is high-value but orthogonal to the activation decline. Verifying memory_31 and memory_91 confirms the magnitude of prior activation gains and whether messaging can be the primary lever this week. Standard experiment scale is appropriate given urgency and single-slot constraint.
